_about: Raid windows. Each raid is one absolute stretch of the weekend, written in the event's own offset (CST, -06:00, in late February) rather than as a recurrence rule — an organiser writing the schedule already knows when 2 AM Saturday is. `venue` must be a key in venues.json and says where the raid is called, not where it is enforced; there is no geofence on a raid. `joinEvents` names the domain events that enrol a player, so a spin raid and a gym raid are pack edits rather than server changes. `karmaMultiplier` is what the window is worth while it is open.

raids.title: Opening Bell
raids.blurb: The first hour. Get a token scanned and claim something before the board empties.

raids.title: Midnight Supply Run
raids.blurb: Every beacon on the Quad pays double for an hour. Wear a coat.

raids.title: Sponsor Hour
raids.blurb: They flew in to meet you. Walk the row while they are all still at their tables.

raids.title: Siege of Altgeld
raids.blurb: Three factions, one bell tower, one hour. Altgeld rings for whoever holds it at the end.

raids.title: The Long Teardown
raids.blurb: The tables do not stack themselves. The last shift of the weekend is worth the most.
